verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents its own registered-agent service: electronic receipt of service-of-process documents with phone notification, plus state forms pre-filled with its agent address. A 'national-registered-agent' offering at $99/year and multi-state registration tracking suggest broad coverage, but no item explicitly states the service is available in every US state. Missing for 10: an explicit all-50-states (plus DC) coverage statement, a per-state availability list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state appointment.
